panel layout and visibility beside the survival and creative inventories; drawn by inventory_effects::paint
one row per effect: icon, then text and background
nine-slice panel background, ambient variant included
name and duration text, clipping with ..., hover tooltip for compact panels
name plus level suffix for amplifier 1-9, folded into panels
galactic word names from the enchant seed (WORDS), drawn in the enchanting option slots
creates the book model for drawing only; the book itself is not drawn (see extractBook)
gap: player: keeps the experience bar up while the table is open; the book tick (tickBook) is not run
open and flip at the partial tick, drawn as the 3D book by item_render/gui.rs::enchanting_book_pages
a new item in the slot turns to a new page (LegacyRandom), the book opens 0.2 a tick while any offer has a cost
grindstone texture and the error sprite when an input is set and there is no result
hanging sign board at 4.5x scale
hopper background for block and minecart hoppers
saddle slot shown for every mount except llamas
armour slot for horse armour wearers and llamas
minor: a survival inventory that stays open when the game mode becomes creative is not switched to the creative screen
gap: minor: the creative screen is chosen when E opens the inventory; no switch while a survival screen is already open
book button at (leftPos+104, height/2-22), same as the crafting placement
Crafting title at x 97 in the survival inventory
effect panels (draw_inventory_effects), slots and widgets
background texture and the player preview (draw_inventory_player)
gap: minor: player only; mounts use mount_menu.rs::draw_mob_preview. Head and body turn toward the cursor as vanilla
release goes through the slot path; a recipe-book press is handled first and has no separate release flag
anvil and smithing backgrounds, with the error sprite
gap: player: Take Book and Done are drawn on every lectern; vanilla shows Take Book only with build permission (mayBuild)
bakes the banner flag model for the preview; the loom is drawn by screen_layout::loom
gap: minor: more than 16 patterns (four rows of four); the displayPatterns check is at the call sites
grey square and pattern sprite on each pattern button (Fill and Atlas draws from screen_layout::loom)
outside test against the container rectangle, plus the recipe book area
selection hint, move the offer's items, and the SelectTrade packet on a server
trade buttons are laid out in draw_merchant and hit-tested in merchant_click
title with the trader level, Trades and Inventory labels
villager background and the out-of-stock sprite
experience bar, with the pending trade's XP
gap: minor: no pointing or resize cursor over the scroller
the seven offer rows from the scroll offset
trade arrow, and the out-of-stock arrow
discount: base count struck through, new count drawn (merchant.rs cost_a)
gap: minor: one offer per wheel step; vanilla uses the float scroll amount
the held scroller follows the cursor while m.dragging (drag_scroll); the wheel is Game::merchant_scroll
gap: player: clicking the scroller does not start a drag (see mouseDragged); the offer buttons work
item tooltip for cost A, cost B or the result under the hovered offer
the editor is filled from the cart's command (Game::open_cart_command_block); Done sends SetCommandMinecart with the command and trackOutput, then clears the last output
page arrows with their hover sprites (page_buttons)
shulker box background texture, drawn with the other container screens
sign board at 3.9x scale, wall signs at 12 rows
the template icons cycle every 30 ticks with a 4 tick cross-fade and the lists are re-read from the template each tick; drawn in Game::draw_station

the base and addition slot icons the template asks for (netherite upgrade: the 11 tools and armour, then the ingot; a trim: the four armour pieces, then the seven materials), EMPTY_TEMPLATE_ICONS for an empty slot
gap: player: onboarding tooltips for empty slots are missing (see extractOnboardingTooltips)
gap: player: the armour stand preview beside the slots is not drawn
the result on a stand without its base plate, arms shown, turned 210 degrees, drawn at scale 25 in the box beside the slots
error sprite at (65, 46) when all inputs are set and there is no result
gap: player: only the upgrade error tooltip exists; the missing-template and slot description tooltips are not drawn
background, scroller and the recipe grid
tooltip of the hovered recipe result
recipe cell sprites: selected and highlighted
recipe result icons in the grid
the scroller position under the cursor while the bar is held (Game::stonecutter_drag); the wheel is Game::stonecutter_scroll
one row of recipes per wheel step, only with more than 12 recipes
more than 12 visible recipes
rows beyond the 3 visible rows, ceil(recipes/4) - 3
minor: unsure: widget-anchored tooltip placement (below the widget, flipped above when it does not fit); Horizon places tooltips at the cursor (ui::tooltip)
the player count drawn left of the status icon: its width from the status line, 8 high and 5 left of the icon, and the hover test on that box (width is the caller's font measure)
the ping sample's names as literal tooltip lines with their § codes styled, then multiplayer.status.and_more for the players left out; the sample's head sprites draw as their names, not as images
